fields.codeOrRecovery: Code from the app, or a recovery code

signup.title: Create an account
signup.heading: Create a Mewvo account
signup.lead: With an account you log in to this website with a username and password. No email is needed. Right after you sign up, you link your Discord account once; that is also how you reset a forgotten password.
signup.usernameHint: {min} to {max} characters: letters, numbers and underscores only.
signup.birthHint: You must be at least {age}. We only check your age and save that you are {age} or older, never the date.
signup.accept: I accept the [Terms and Conditions](/terms) and the [Privacy Policy](/privacy).

login.title: Log in
login.heading: Log in to your Mewvo account

twoStep.title: Two-step login
twoStep.heading: Enter your login code
twoStep.lead: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Mewvo. Lost your phone? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.
twoStep.foot: The code step lasts 5 minutes. After that, [log in again](/me/login-password).

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.heading: Forgot your password?
forgot.lead: Log in with the Discord account that is linked to your Mewvo account. Then you choose a new password.
forgot.foot: Mewvo asks Discord only who you are. If two-step login is on, you still enter a code from your app after the new password. No Discord account linked? Then the password cannot be reset; [create a new account](/me/signup).

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.heading: Choose a new password
reset.codeHint: The 6-digit code from your app, or one of your recovery codes.
reset.foot: Saving ends every other login of this account and logs you in here. This form works for 10 minutes.

link.title: Link your Discord
link.heading: Link your Discord account
link.lead: Logged in as **{username}**. One more step: link your Discord account. Your Mewvo account works only once it is linked. The first 100 accounts to link get Mewvo Pro for {bonus}.
link.foot: Mewvo asks Discord only who you are (the identify permission): no email, no servers. One Discord account can be linked to one Mewvo account. If you forget your password, you reset it by logging in with this Discord account. An account that never links Discord is deleted after 7 days.

letter.heading: Your 1-letter username
letter.foot: You can claim a 1-letter username only once. Your current username stops working when you claim one.

linkResult.repeat: Your Discord account is linked. This Discord account was linked to a Mewvo account before, so it does not get the early-account bonus again.
linkResult.proAndLetter: You are number {n} to link a Discord account to Mewvo. You get Mewvo Pro for {bonus}, and you can pick a 1-letter username below.
linkResult.pro: You are number {n} to link a Discord account to Mewvo. You get Mewvo Pro for {bonus}.
linkResult.proFailedAndLetter: You are number {n} to link a Discord account to Mewvo. {bonus} of Pro were due, but they could not be added: {note} You can still pick a 1-letter username below.
linkResult.proFailed: You are number {n} to link a Discord account to Mewvo. {bonus} of Pro were due, but they could not be added: {note}
linkResult.letter: You are number {n} to link a Discord account to Mewvo. You can pick a 1-letter username below.
linkResult.none: You are number {n} to link a Discord account to Mewvo. The early-account bonuses went to the first 100 accounts, so there is no bonus for this one.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.heading: Two-step login is on
recovery.lead: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one works once, if you lose your authenticator app. They are shown only now.

totp.title: Turn on two-step login
totp.heading: Turn on two-step login
totp.lead: Add Mewvo to an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
totp.stepAdd: In your authenticator app, choose to add an account by entering a key.
totp.stepKey: Enter this key: {key} (time based, 6 digits, 30 seconds).
totp.stepUri: Or paste this address, if your app accepts it: {uri}

plan.heading: Your plan
plan.foot: The plan belongs to your Discord account, not to this Mewvo account.

bonus.skipped: Link #{n}: {bonus} of Pro were due but not added. {reason}

tooLate.one: Link #{n}: no Pro bonus (it went to the first link).
tooLate.other: Link #{n}: no Pro bonus (it went to the first {count} links).

settings.title: Account settings
settings.unlinkFoot: A Mewvo account needs a linked Discord account: after unlinking, you can only link one again (or delete the account). A plan stays with your Discord account. A Discord account gets the early-account bonus only once.

language.heading: Language of Mewvo's DMs
language.lead: Mewvo DMs you in this language, and uses it for answers only you see on Discord, in every server. A language role in a server comes first there.
language.label: Language

password.heading: Change password
password.newHint: At least {min} characters. You stay logged in here; other logins end.

twoStepSettings.heading: Two-step login
twoStepSettings.on: Two-step login is **on** since {date}. Recovery codes left: {left}.
twoStepSettings.off: Two-step login is **off**. When it is on, you also enter a code from an authenticator app when you log in.

delete.heading: Delete account
delete.lead: This deletes your Mewvo account: username, password and two-step login. It does not delete moderation records or a plan on your Discord account. See the [Privacy Policy](/privacy).

deleted.title: Account deleted
deleted.heading: Your account was deleted
deleted.lead: Your Mewvo account is gone and you are logged out. A plan on your Discord account stays with it, and moderation records are not affected.

flash.letterClaimed: Your username is now {username}. Use it to log in.
flash.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. Other logins were ended.
flash.unlinked: Your Discord account was unlinked. Link a Discord account again to keep using your Mewvo account.
flash.languageSaved: Saved: Mewvo will DM you in {language}.
flash.languageCleared: Cleared: Mewvo uses each server's language for your DMs again.

logoutAll.heading: Log out
logoutAll.lead: Log out here, or on all devices: that ends every login of this account and of your linked Discord account, on the website and in the dashboard, this one too.
logoutAll.done: Every login of your account on this website and in the dashboard has ended, on every device.
